# Actual validation

Node v22.14.0, Linux x64, Cursor VM. Heavy test commands ran under `flock /home/ubuntu/.cache/pilot-ae18-build.lock`; unrelated jobs were preserved. No dependency installation, model job, production deploy, provider purchase or charge was performed. Available host memory stayed above 5 GiB at the recorded checks.

The first actual service test was `node --test services/continuous-monitoring/test/00-mounted-journey.test.mjs`, using a real mounted changing HTTP origin, SQLite on disk, separate API and worker processes, and a public-API consumer. It passed. [first-mounted-run.json](first-mounted-run.json) records two GETs, 76 received bytes, 13 ms measured observation runtime, 4,825 retained payload bytes, one delivered/acknowledged price diff (10 to 14), and two API restarts. These are local mounted-origin measurements, not production latency, public drift, demand or a cost estimate.

The final direct package test command was:

```sh
flock /home/ubuntu/.cache/pilot-ae18-build.lock bash -o pipefail -c 'node --test --test-concurrency=1 services/continuous-monitoring/test/*.test.mjs 2>&1 | tee services/continuous-monitoring/evidence/service-tests.tap'
```

[service-tests.tap](service-tests.tap) records 22 passed, zero failed or skipped. Coverage includes actual sockets and processes, unchanged conditional GET, missing fields, timeout, truncated/partial/encoded/oversized responses, redirects, private DNS/addresses, cancellation during a read, two workers racing, cross-monitor source cooldown and fairness, worker crashes before/after staging, lease fencing, immutable outputs, retry/readback, lost acknowledgement, tenant/reader boundaries, finite expiry, no-charge paid entitlement, retained consumption after entitlement expiry, persistent quotas and retention.

An earlier 17-test run exposed four failures: response-destruction error precedence, a slow monitor being admitted repeatedly inside a tick, and two concurrent SQLite-initialization races. The next 17-test run passed after fixes. The final 22-test run includes those regressions and the added entitlement and HTTP-402 checks.

The existing `packages/change-monitor/test/projection-integration.test.mjs` was also run alongside the new entitlement tests: eight of nine combined tests passed. Its live `cold install fetches the public snapshot, seeds one change, restarts, corrects, and cancels` test failed with `public baseline outcome evidence_unavailable evidence incomparable`. This existing check assumes today's public MoltJobs reading is fully comparable. The current upstream supplies partial metrics. Shared foundation source/tests were left unchanged. The inherited failure output (with trailing blank-line whitespace normalized for Git) is retained in [foundation-tests.tap](foundation-tests.tap). A separate positive-name-filtered offline run is recorded in [foundation-offline-tests.tap](foundation-offline-tests.tap). An initial negative-prefix filter also matched the ancestor filename and therefore reran the live check; that failed run was preserved rather than relabelled as a passing offline run.

The explicit `scripts/public-read.mjs` reads only the existing free Observatory snapshot through the default production HTTPS/DNS policy, without the demo exception. [public-observatory-read.json](public-observatory-read.json) records a 33,672-byte HTTPS read in 675 ms, `partial_metrics` unavailable evidence, and a consumer acknowledgement/readback of that real negative alert through the API. This is a truthful useful negative observation when metrics are partial; it is not a fabricated baseline or public change. [public-observatory-read-initial.json](public-observatory-read-initial.json) preserves the earlier read before adding the maintained envelope-to-projection normalization.

Deployment recipes were rendered into `/tmp/ae18-monitor-unit-preview` with this VM's actual Node executable, repository path and existing user. `systemd-analyze verify` on all three rendered files exited 0. The unrendered example `/usr/bin/node` does not exist on this VM, so checking the unrendered templates correctly failed; this is why the recipe requires real target paths. No unit was installed or started. Production user permissions, ingress, disk, supervisor operation, cadence under load, restore and customer acceptance remain unverified deployment work. `git diff --check` passed. A repository-wide site build was unnecessary for this service-only change.
